subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor a current-main port of this narrow 24-hour cron timeline, or pause/close it until the broader calendar design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40644 is settled?
rationale: This is a new Control UI product surface on a conflicting external branch, and the remaining decision is feature scope plus ownership of a non-trivial port, not a deterministic one-line repair.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Timeline Port
options.body: Rebase or replace this branch against the current route-owned Cron page, fix the status/scheduler/i18n blockers, and track daily/weekly calendar behavior separately.

options.title: Pause For Full Calendar Design
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and ask for a broader day/week/stats/editing design before accepting a timeline-only slice.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close the PR and linked feature issue if maintainers decide cron visualization belongs outside core or is not planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Timeline Port
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace this branch against the current route-owned Cron page, fix the status/scheduler/i18n blockers, and track daily/weekly calendar behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron UI and cron runtime history makes steipete the strongest routing signal for deciding whether to sponsor the current-main port.
